text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Syrian newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Hafez al-Assad talks by telephone with Egyptian leader Hosni Mubarak.
- Lebanese President Elias Hrawi affirms adherence to U.N. resolution 425.
- President Assad discusses latest developments in the region during telephone conversation with Egypt's President Mubarak.
- Increased international condemnation of Israel's (Prime Minister Benjamin) Netanyahu. Washington replies to criticism and affirms its opposition to Israeli settlements.
- Arab League welcomes Oman's and Tunisia's measures on freezing ties with Israel.
- Egypt: Nobody could accept peace in accordance with Israel's conditions.
